info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Fitness Memberships Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: The Cancel Fitness Memberships API allows users to effectively cancel their existing fitness membership subscriptions, streamlining the membership management process. This endpoint is primarily utilized by gym members who wish to terminate their membership, ensuring that their cancellations are processed promptly and accurately. By using this API, developers can integrate membership cancellation features into their applications, enhancing user control over fitness services. Common use cases include mobile apps for gyms or fitness centers that offer convenience for members to manage their memberships digitally.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel their existing membership. Upon successful cancellation, the membership will be marked as inactive and relevant notifications will be sent.

requestBody.description: Request body to cancel a membership. This operation expects a JSON payload containing the necessary identification or details required to process the cancellation of the membership.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body that is sent when cancelling a membership.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelResponse_2.title: Cancel Membership Response

status.description: Indicates if the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the transaction.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the membership after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.
